facts.text: Audrey expressed that her dogs bring her a lot of happiness and joy.

evidence.quote: Seeing them happy fills my heart with joy. They bring me so much happiness.
They really do bring joy don't they. It's wonderful.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that she has a tattoo of her four dogs and recently added more drawings to it.

evidence.quote: I think i've said this so many times, but I really can't imagine my life without them - my little family. They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship. Remember I had a tattoo of my four dogs? So I went to the tattoo parlor and got some more drawings on the tattoo.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that she might get another tattoo if she decides to get another dog in the future.

evidence.quote: Unless someday I decide to get another dog. Maybe I'll get another tattoo when that happens.
